mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline and the federal funds rate is low, it signals weak demand with accommodative policy that reduces growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when HOUST < 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven expansion regime, rising industrial production signals strong manufacturing activity that boosts corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when INDPRO MoM growth > 0.5% or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.3% or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 900,000 units signals weak residential demand that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 900.0 or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls grow above 100,000 jobs and unemployment is below 6.5%, it signals a strong labor market that supports consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market with low unemployment
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when PAYEMS > 100.0 and UNRATE < 6.5% or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime, a rising consumer price index signals inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth < 2.0% or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
